interval_validation: Means/counts/contrasts are locally recomputed from public tables. Bootstrap intervals and permutation summaries are preserved with source hashes; no claim that this slim package re-extracts private activations.
sanitization: No machine paths, private host names, authentication material, transport/session data, raw prompts, raw token IDs, tensor arrays or model coefficients. Scientific IDs, source/completion hashes and aggregate token counts are retained. Offline prediction rows use publication-local aliases.
